csv_project_name: Conslt for Parks Recreation and Open Space Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Marysville Parks, Culture and Recreation Department is seeking proposals from qualified consultant firms to provide professional services to develop a 20-year Parks, Recreation and Open Space (PROS) Master Plan. The PROS Master Plan will provide a fiscally sound framework for prioritized park acquisition, park maintenance, facility capital needs and programming in alignment with the Department s mission and public priorities. Develop site plans which consider community input and priorities, future growth demands, consider existing site conditions and past planning efforts and balance financial viability at three specific park sites: Twin Lakes, Strawberry Fields and the downtown waterfront.
